title: Fog on the Bog
lines: Fog sat on the bog. Tom and Mom jog.
"I can not see the hut," said Mom.
Tom did look and look in the fog.
A red pot! It sits on a log.
"The pot is at the hut!" said Tom.
Mom and Tom jog to the red pot.
The hut sits at the log, in the fog.
"You got us to the hut," said Mom.

questions.ask: Why could Mom not see the hut?
questions.listenFor: The fog. Lines one and two say it. Let your child reread rather than being told.

questions.ask: What did Tom spot that showed him where the hut was?
questions.listenFor: A red pot sitting on a log. Lines four and five say it. This is the turn of the story.

questions.ask: What would you use to mark the way to your door? Tell me why that.
questions.listenFor: Any answer counts. You are listening for a reason that shows they understood why the red pot worked in fog.
